4555 sardinos {sar'-dee-nos}

與 4556 同源; 形容詞

欽定本 - sardine 1; 1

1) 一種紅色的寶石,有兩類,前者因其肉色澤,故稱為肉紅玉髓( carnelian), 後者稱為 肉紅石髓 (sard) (#啟4:3|)
record.edic_text:
4555 sardinos {sar'-dee-nos}

from the same as 4556;; adj

AV - sardine 1; 1

1) a sardius, a precious stone of which there are two types, the former
   is called a carnelian (because flesh coloured) and the latter a sard
